gestalts.sense: correct a software or configuration defect

gestalts.recoverability_note: No single unambiguous gestalt; preserve lexically.

gestalts.sense: origin and evidentiary status of a proposition
externally testable condition licensing loop exit

loops.exit_predicate: The unchanged selected test suite exits successfully.
loops.initial_test: Run the unchanged tests and capture failures.
loops.name: Unit-test repair
loops.objective: Make the selected test suite pass without weakening its assertions.

loops.exit_predicate: The original reproducer and regression test both pass.
loops.initial_test: Execute the smallest known reproducer and inspect the observed result.
loops.name: Defect reproduction and repair
loops.objective: Reproduce and correct a reported defect.

loops.exit_predicate: All required CI checks report success on the candidate commit.
loops.initial_test: Inspect the failing job and reproduce its command in a clean environment.
loops.name: CI failure repair
loops.objective: Restore the declared continuous-integration checks.

loops.exit_predicate: Every required policy and grounding predicate passes, or the output is withheld.
loops.initial_test: Inspect the candidate model output, policy, and cited evidence.
loops.name: LLM output governance gate
loops.objective: Release only output satisfying the declared policy and evidence constraints.

loops.exit_predicate: Every material claim is supported, qualified, or removed.
loops.initial_test: Compare each material claim with the retrieved source content.
loops.name: Retrieval grounding
loops.objective: Ground a claim in directly supporting retrieved evidence.

loops.exit_predicate: A fresh external read confirms the intended postcondition.
loops.initial_test: Inspect the current external state and define the intended postcondition.
loops.name: Tool-call verification
loops.objective: Verify that an external tool operation produced the intended state.

loops.exit_predicate: One fresh bidirectional chain is committed with SingleEnvelope equal to one.
loops.initial_test: Inspect nonce, sender, turn lineage, envelope count, and payload freshness.
loops.name: Agent relay integrity
loops.objective: Accept only fresh, single-envelope peer contributions.

loops.exit_predicate: A fresh read returns the same normalized record and closure hash.
loops.initial_test: Inspect the normalized record and its closure hash before writing.
loops.name: Memory write-read verification
loops.objective: Store and recover the same canonical record.

loops.exit_predicate: Clean installation and smoke tests succeed from the locked declaration.
loops.initial_test: Install from the locked declaration in a clean environment and capture resolver errors.
loops.name: Dependency resolution
loops.objective: Produce a reproducible environment satisfying declared dependency constraints.

loops.exit_predicate: The complete evaluation executes and its measured metrics are recorded without threshold revision.
loops.initial_test: Verify model, dataset, split, metric, seed, and thresholds are frozen.
loops.name: Model evaluation gate
loops.objective: Evaluate a frozen model and dataset against preregistered thresholds.

loops.exit_predicate: After correction, every reviewed absolute dX and dY is at most 10 pixels, control-point identities and CRS are confirmed, and a cartographer accepts the overlay comparison; not a universal mapping accuracy claim.
loops.initial_test: Inspect the ground-control-point table dX[pixels] and dY[pixels] errors and review digitized points and entered coordinates when the exercise error exceeds 10 pixels.
loops.name: Review forestry map ground-control residuals
loops.objective: Prepare a legacy forestry map registration for reviewer acceptance.

loops.exit_predicate: A fresh full-layer validation reports zero overlaps under the same approved rule, and a cartographer confirms the corrections preserve the intended boundaries; no claim of legal boundary accuracy.
loops.initial_test: Apply the active Must not overlap rule to all features and inspect errors by type, layer and feature ID.
loops.name: Resolve reviewed polygon overlap findings
loops.objective: Bring a thematic polygon coverage into conformance with an approved no-overlap rule without erasing legitimate features.

loops.exit_predicate: Fresh samples over a quality-engineer-defined verification window show no outside-limit points or signals under the same approved pattern rules; documented cause disposition is accepted by the engineer. This does not certify product conformance.
loops.initial_test: Inspect control-chart points for outside-limit observations and systematic nonrandom patterns; either finding warrants investigation.
loops.name: Review a statistical process-control signal
loops.objective: Resolve a reviewed chart signal using documentary evidence and an approved corrective-action plan.

loops.exit_predicate: New post-intervention data remain stable and meet the preapproved target/variation criteria over the approved verification window, with quality-engineer sign-off; missing specification or stability evidence is unresolved, not success.
loops.initial_test: Check whether the statistically stable process has an average level too high or too low, or unacceptable variability.
loops.name: Review stable but off-target process performance
loops.objective: Prepare and assess a reviewed improvement proposal for a stable but unacceptable process.

loops.exit_predicate: Fresh logger records for the agreed post-change window are stable and within the approved setpoint ranges, with conservator acceptance; close this corrective episode only, not ongoing monitoring.
loops.initial_test: Determine whether temperature and RH levels are stable and within the recommended set point and permissible range.
loops.name: Review a museum collection microclimate deviation
loops.objective: Assess whether a reviewed non-mechanical preservation change restores approved temperature/RH conditions.

loops.exit_predicate: Fresh before/after-comparable site records satisfy all approved visible-light, UV, heat and exposure-duration criteria, and the conservator accepts effectiveness; ongoing exposure monitoring continues.
loops.initial_test: Gather baseline and ongoing lighting information and assess required light levels, UV blocking, IR and visible-light control.
loops.name: Review the effectiveness of a collection lighting plan
loops.objective: Assess whether a reviewed lighting-protection change meets collection-specific exposure criteria.

loops.exit_predicate: Fresh full verification completes without reported errors (including required WAL parsing); this is not proof of restorability.
loops.initial_test: Use pg_verifybackup to check a pg_basebackup backup against its server-generated backup_manifest.
loops.name: Reacquire and verify a base backup
loops.objective: Obtain a plain-format base-backup candidate with no reported manifest/file/checksum/required-WAL verification failures.

loops.exit_predicate: Fresh pg_checksums --check -D CLUSTER_DIR completes with exit status zero over the whole cluster; no --filenode narrowing.
loops.initial_test: With the server shut down cleanly, use pg_checksums --check to check cluster checksums; verification exits zero only without checksum errors.
loops.name: Enable checksums on an approved offline cluster and verify
loops.objective: For an approved, cleanly stopped offline cluster with disabled checksums, enable checksums and require a complete clean checksum scan.

loops.exit_predicate: Fresh full-read identify report shows actual WEBP format, expected source dimensions and no decode/corruption diagnostics.
loops.initial_test: Use magick identify to inspect actual image format and dimensions and report incomplete or corrupt image data; use +ping for accurate pixel characteristics.
loops.name: Convert a derivative and verify actual image format
loops.objective: Produce a fully readable WebP derivative while preserving source and expected dimensions.

loops.exit_predicate: Fresh normalized all-channel RMSE is at or below the explicitly supplied project threshold, comparison finishes without errors, and human visual review accepts the derivative; absent threshold means unresolved.
loops.initial_test: Use magick compare -verbose -metric rmse to measure differences between the reference image and its reconstruction, including the all-channel result.
loops.name: Re-encode and remeasure reconstruction error
loops.objective: Produce a WebP derivative satisfying a preapproved normalized RMSE threshold relative to a preserved reference.

loops.exit_predicate: Fresh inspection shows a present, adequate brief description of current page content and a title distinct from every page in the declared comparison set, confirmed by reviewer.
loops.initial_test: Check that a page title adequately and briefly describes page content and differs from titles of other pages on the website.
loops.name: Review, revise and recheck page title
loops.objective: Give one scoped page a brief descriptive title distinguishable from other scoped site pages.

loops.exit_predicate: Fresh heading check finds headings, a starting H1, no blank headings or skipped subsection levels, no unmarked visual headings, and a reviewer confirms descriptive text and nesting matching the content.
loops.initial_test: Check heading presence, starting H1, skipped or blank levels, missing visual headings, descriptive text and nesting against page content.
loops.name: Review, repair and recheck heading structure
loops.objective: Make scoped page headings describe content and represent a coherent nested structure.

operators.definition: Inspect externally available evidence without inventing a result.
Model, imagine, remember, or compare a candidate state internally.
Represent a licensed intention, plan, or operative thought.
